name: Webhook
caption: When a webhook is received

configuration.description: HTTP methods the AutoFlow webhook proxy accepts for this flow (array of strings). Upper-cased and de-duplicated on read; an absent, non-array or empty value means ['POST']. Enforced by the proxy, not by Business Central. Sent to the portal when the flow is registered.

InstantReturn: the caller immediately gets responseStatusCode / responseContentType with an empty body and the flow runs in the background. WaitForResponse: the flow runs synchronously until a Respond to Webhook step answers, the flow ends, or timeoutSec elapses. Any other value (including integers) is treated as InstantReturn.

WaitForResponse only: how long the synchronous phase may run. The limit is checked between steps (a running step is not interrupted). When it is exceeded, the caller gets the default response and the rest of the flow continues in the background. 0 or less means no time limit.
Status code of the default response: always in InstantReturn mode; in WaitForResponse mode when the flow ends or times out before a Respond to Webhook step.
Content-Type of the default response (truncated to 100 characters). The default response body is always empty.

outputs.name: Payload
outputs.when: always; request body as JSON object text. A body that is not a JSON object becomes '{}'.

outputs.name: Method
outputs.when: always; the HTTP method forwarded by the proxy

outputs.name: Headers
outputs.when: always; request headers as forwarded by the proxy (text)

outputs.name: Query
outputs.when: always; query string as forwarded by the proxy (text)

rules.check: configuration.allowedMethods should be an array of method strings. Not enforced: anything else falls back to ['POST'].
rules.message: (no message; a non-array falls back to ['POST'])

rules.check: configuration.responseMode should be the string 'InstantReturn' or 'WaitForResponse'. Not enforced: anything else (including the integers 0/1) silently behaves like InstantReturn.
configuration.timeoutSec should be > 0. Not enforced: 0 or a negative value means the synchronous phase has no time limit.
responseStatusCode should be a valid HTTP status code. Not checked by AutoFlow.
The configure dialog only opens on Business Central online (SaaS); on-premises it shows this message and changes nothing.
rules.message: The webhook trigger is only available on Business Central online (SaaS). It cannot be configured on-premises.

rules.check: Publish registers the flow with the AutoFlow portal. Without a portal API key the publish still succeeds, the registration stays Pending, no URL is minted, and the flow card shows this note.
rules.message: No AutoFlow portal API key on this environment. Connect it to the AutoFlow portal (AutoFlow Setup) before publishing a webhook flow.

rules.check: A portal error does not fail the publish. The registration is marked Pending with this note on the flow card and can be retried from there (Retry registration) or by publishing again.

The portal refuses the registration when the production environment has no paid AutoFlow license (free tier; before 27.0.40: a package below Premium). Sandboxes are exempt. The publish still succeeds, but the webhook is not live; the flow card shows registration status 'License Required' and this message.
rules.message: The webhook trigger requires a paid AutoFlow license; the free tier does not include it. License AutoFlow in the AutoFlow portal, then republish this flow.

rules.check: The portal registered the webhook, but an administrator must still grant admin consent before calls are accepted. The flow card shows this status with a link to grant consent.
rules.message: Administrator consent required - click to grant.

rules.check: Publishing tries to enable the webhook proxy's application in the environment, which needs administrator rights. If that fails, the publish still succeeds and the flow card shows this note.
rules.message: The webhook is registered, but an administrator must enable the AutoFlow webhook proxy in this environment – use the "Enable webhook proxy" action.

rules.check: An incoming call whose unique id matches no published webhook flow is rejected.
rules.message: No webhook flow is registered for unique id '%1'.

rules.check: WaitForResponse: a step that defers the run (Sleep) fails the flow while the synchronous phase is still running. Put such steps after the Respond to Webhook step, which ends the synchronous phase.
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

notes: Cloud-only (Business Central online). Requires the environment to be connected to the AutoFlow portal and, in production, a paid AutoFlow license of any model (per user, per company or per tenant); the portal refuses the registration otherwise. Sandboxes need no license. Before 27.0.40: AutoFlow Premium or higher.

The endpoint URL is minted by the AutoFlow portal on first publish and shown on the flow card; it is not part of the flow definition. A copied or imported flow, or one restored into another tenant, environment or company, registers again on publish and gets a new URL.

Authentication: callers call the proxy URL; the proxy authenticates to Business Central with its own application identity and enforces allowedMethods. The proxy's application user needs the permissions the flow's steps require.
InstantReturn: the trigger records the execution, queues it as its own Job Queue entry and answers at once with the default response. The flow runs in the background and commits after every step.

WaitForResponse: the flow runs synchronously in the web-service call. The first Respond to Webhook step ends the synchronous phase: its status, content type and body become the HTTP response, and any steps after it continue in the background. If the flow ends, or timeoutSec is exceeded (checked between steps), the caller gets the default response; a timed-out flow continues in the background. If the synchronous phase fails, the caller gets HTTP 500, content type text/plain, body = the error text, the execution is marked Error and the database changes of the synchronous phase are rolled back. Otherwise the synchronous phase is committed once, at the end of the call.
No recurring Job Queue entry is created on publish.
Picker filter: Respond to Webhook is ONLY offered in Webhook flows. Return SubFlow Output, Return PDF, Set report file name, Set document field values and Prevent page close are hidden.
Payload is always JSON object text. An empty body, a JSON array or a non-JSON body becomes '{}'.
